transcript: My friend, if your hands are cold, your feet tingle, or your mind feels heavy. Your body is whispering one thing. My circulation is weak. In Chinese wisdom we say, when the river slows, everything suffers. Your blood is that river. When it flows well, you feel warm, clear and alive. When it slows, the body becomes tired and dull, but the river can flow again. Let me give you three simple teachings. One, warm the body, warm meals, warm tea, warm showers. Warmth opens the vessels and wakes the blood. Two, soften your tension, relax your shoulders, take slow breaths. A calm mind allows the blood to move freely. Three, move a little every day. Stretch, walk, circle your joints. Even small movements open the channels. Remember, my friend, good circulation is good energy, good aging and a peaceful heart. If you want to heal deeper, I created my healing e-books and the 30-day healing journey to guide your mind and body step by step. You can find them through the link on my profile. Comment H-E-A-L if you want the guidance and follow for more daily wisdom.
